integrity: All counts are exact integers, verified by exhaustive binary-word enumeration and a second independently implemented prefix-difference enumeration; all software and data are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Finite full-composition-multiset fiber classification for binary lengths one through twenty-three only; no noisy-channel or longer-length theorem. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exact composition-multiset ambiguity spectrum for binary words of lengths \(1\)–\(23\)
